dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent, high-contrast horizontal white bands on the flight feathers with sharp, well-defined boundaries against a dark-gray background.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Distinct dark, roughly rectangular patch visible on the lateral posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and indistinct transition between the gray crown and the gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Localized focal patch of reddish-brown pigment on the lower flank/ventral region; extensive black and white barring also present on the visible rectrices (tail feathers).
